newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends mixed, nearbys down on stocks.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends mixed, nearbys down on stocks.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended mixed on Monday with nearby contracts down on high USDA quarterly stocks figures, traders said.
"The long-grain (stocks) numbers were higher than most market participants expected," a floor source said. "That weighed on nearbys."
USDA on Monday put rough rice stocks at 80.7 million cwt.

New-crop months were higher on low USDA prospective plantings figures. USDA put long-grain rice acreage at 2.07 million acres, above last year's 1.98 million but below trade expectations, floor sources said.

"I don't see any way we're going to build stocks with that kind of acreage," a floor trader said. "We need to buy some Export demand was picking up. Traders cited news overnight that Japan's third largest convenience store chain began stocking Arkansas rice on its shelves. A FamilyMart Co Ltd spokesman said the rice was nearly 40 percent cheaper than Japanese rice.
Rice ended seven cents per cwt lower to five cents higher with May off seven at $11.65.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 400 lots, compared with Thursday's actual volume of 1,121 lots.
